Mobile's full-screen menu (`VPNavScreen.vue`) renders items in a fixed order; `Layout.vue` currently injects the raw desktop `ThemeSelector` (hover-dropdown icon) into a trailing slot — wrong position and wrong shape (should be an accordion like the language chooser).
